name: Anderson Collection at Stanford University
notes: Ennead's building (2014) on Stanford's arts district: three horizontal bars - a glazed ground floor set back under a cantilevered tan gallery box, subtly bow-tie in plan, with window bands recessed into each side and framed in zinc, topped by a smaller bar of clerestory glass under a zinc cap; campus oaks round it. Footprint and orientation from the ground file (about 60 x 36 m, long east-west); the massing from Architectural Record, Architizer and The Architect's Newspaper. Refined 29 Sep 2026 (no photographs reachable): the gallery box clad in pale tan stone (limestone here) rather than grey-brown; the zinc cap over the clerestory made a thin lid that overhangs it, not a heavy parapet; the campus oaks made coast live oaks, broad and low. Guessed: heights (about 17 m overall), the band positions, the entrance on the south.
